messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Sertraline carries a boxed warning, the FDA's most serious type of warning.
Antidepressants increased the risk of suicidal thoughts and behavior in children, teenagers, and young adults in short-term studies.
Pooled analyses of placebo-controlled antidepressant trials were conducted.
The trials covered about 77,000 adults and more than 4,500 children and teenagers.
The risk of suicidal thoughts and behaviors in people aged 24 and under was higher with an antidepressant than with placebo.
The risk varied considerably between different antidepressants.
The risk also varied by condition.
The highest rate of risk was in people being treated for depression.
The difference between antidepressant and placebo, per 1,000 patients treated, was:
Age (years) | Difference compared with placebo
Under 18 | 14 more patients with suicidal thoughts or behaviors
18 to 24 | 5 more patients
25 to 64 | 1 fewer patient
65 and over | 6 fewer patients
It is not known whether this risk continues beyond about four months of treatment.
Triplet: ["Risk", "not known to continue beyond", "about four months of treatment"]

The relation 'not known to continue beyond' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject risk or effect is not known to persist past the time frame specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has unknown effect on': The effect of the subject drug on the entity specified by the object entity is not known.
B. 'not same as': The subject drug's effect is not the same as the event or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'not for use in': The subject entity is not intended for use in the specified situation or condition described by the object entity.
D. 'is not': The subject entity does not belong to or is not classified as the object entity.
E. 'has unstudied dose': The subject drug has not been studied at the dose specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
